Otech TZe-S251 24mm x 8m Laminated Tape – Black on White (Extra Strength Adhesive)

The Brother TZe-S251 is a 24mm (0.94") wide, 8-meter (26.2 ft) long laminated label tape cartridge featuring black text on a white background. Part of Brother’s TZe Extra Strength Adhesive series, this tape is specially designed for industrial and demanding labeling applications. It adheres more securely to rough, textured, and powder-coated surfaces, making it ideal for use on metal, plastic, and other challenging materials.

Key Features:

  • Tape Width: 24mm
  • Tape Length: 8 meters
  • Color: Black text on White background
  • Adhesive: Extra Strength – suitable for tough surfaces
  • Durability: Laminated for resistance to water, fading, abrasion, chemicals, and extreme temperatures
  • Compatible with: Brother P-touch label makers that use TZe tapes (check your model for compatibility)
